title: update_state with Overwrite on a plain key persists the Overwrite wrapper instead of its payload (LastValue / LastValueAfterFinish / UntrackedValue)
observed_behavior: After a normal run, graph.update_state(cfg, {'x': Overwrite('replaced')}) on a plain (non-reducer) key stores the Overwrite wrapper itself: get_state(cfg).values returns {'x': Overwrite(value='replaced', ...)} instead of {'x': 'replaced'}. No error is raised at update time; consumers fail later.
structure_focus: update_state replace-write on a LastValue channel; Overwrite unwrapping consistency across channel types
notes: Open, label external. Single-node graph plus checkpointer, so the fixture is fully offline. Root cause per issue: LastValue.update (also LastValueAfterFinish/UntrackedValue) assigns values[-1] without the _get_overwrite check that BinaryOperatorAggregate and DeltaChannel perform. A focused PR (#9032) unwraps the wrapper in the single-value channels. The issue also includes a direct channel-level repro, which is not reproduced here because the deliverable is a graph fixture.
